conformal.APS: secondary; stable descending probability, class-index tie break; cumulative probability through candidate minus U*p_candidate; include if score<=q
conformal.k: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); kth order statistic or infinity if k>n
conformal.random_uniforms: PCG64 seed 20261024 for calibration and 20261025 for test; one U per row shared across candidate labels; identical uniforms across heads/raw-vs-TS
conformal.single_label_rule: accept iff set size=1, otherwise abstain

dataset.license_note: Original README permits academic research and non-commercial use. Raw text stays local. No commercial or redistribution permission inferred.

encoder.pooling: native last nonpadding token then L2 normalization
encoder.profile: unprompted document mode; not claim optimal classification prompting

falsifiable_primary_hypotheses.adaptation: logistic accuracy minus centroid accuracy >0 and paired 95% lower bound >0; point <=0 means no demonstrated benefit, otherwise uncertain
falsifiable_primary_hypotheses.calibration: logistic raw NLL minus TS NLL >0 and paired 95% lower bound >0; point <=0 means no demonstrated benefit, otherwise uncertain
falsifiable_primary_hypotheses.pilot_utility: logistic TS LAC singleton acceptance >=0.5 AND Wilson95 upper selective-error bound <=0.1; not qualification even if satisfied

heads.centroid: normalize each class mean of normalized features; score cosine

logistic.objective: mean cross entropy + 0.001/2 * sum(W**2), bias unpenalized
logistic.selection: primary adaptation comparator against centroid; no test-driven tuning

ridge.objective: centered one-hot least squares with lambda 1.0; unpenalized intercept

invalidation: snapshot drift observed at guarded checkpoints
test labels influence any fitting or hyperparameter
limits: 960 historical sampled public texts; one fixed split; not full AG News score
exact full-text dedup cannot remove story/source or semantic overlap
90% marginal prediction-set coverage is not 90% accepted-label accuracy and not OOD guarantee
no future-family efficacy, original five-model parity, production resource/CAS/signature closure

classification: multiclass Brier sum of squared class residuals

paired_bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5%,97.5%; descriptive finite-sample uncertainty, not distribution-shift guarantee

sets: singleton conditional error and Wilson 95% interval

selection: NFKC and collapse whitespace of title plus description; casefolded normalized full-text SHA256 group. Remove all official train/test overlap groups from both pools and label-conflict groups. Choose first row of each remaining group. Globally sort SHA256(salt|officialsplit|group), not label-stratified. First 320/next160/next160 training groups; first320 official-test groups. Salt hepta-public-head-pilot-v1.

temperature.algorithm: deterministic 100-iteration golden-section search in log-temperature [-5,5]; include raw T=1 and endpoints as candidates
temperature.boundary_status: record near-boundary optimum; no automatic repair
temperature.objective: mean cross entropy of logits / exp(t)
